title: Chart-Intersection Graph Theorem
graph: Gamma_K on 240 local K33 charts, adjacent iff charts share one W33 nonedge
interpretation: The 240-chart overlap graph is not SRG, but it has a rigid integral spectrum containing the protected 81 multiplicity at eigenvalue -1 and a W33-like 24+24 conjugate pair at +/-9 and -3.
boundary: Adjacency is chart overlap by one nonedge only; this is not the Levi flag line graph.
